pack.title: Salons spas upsells
pack.description: Decline an extra service without apologizing.

scenarios.setting: During your haircut, the stylist repeatedly offers an unplanned treatment.
scenarios.jab: Your hair really needs this treatment today.
scenarios.goal: Decline an extra service without apologizing.

replies.line: I'm keeping today's appointment to the cut we agreed.
replies.why: It anchors the visit to the agreed service rather than debating your hair.
replies.delivery: Pause, then say “I'm keeping today's appointment to the cut we” at a steady, conversational volume. ” with a relaxed expression and no apology.

replies.why: It declines clearly while preserving ordinary courtesy.
replies.delivery: Say “No treatment today, thanks” clearly, then stop instead of adding a defense. ” with a relaxed expression and no apology.

replies.line: Thanks for the suggestion; I'd like to stick with the cut today.
replies.why: It acknowledges their advice without accepting the extra service.
replies.delivery: Keep “Thanks for the suggestion” warm and unhurried; finish the request clearly. ” with a relaxed expression and no apology.

replies.line: My hair and my budget booked the basic package.
replies.why: The joke concerns your plans rather than the stylist's judgment.
replies.delivery: Keep “My hair and my budget booked the basic” light; let the joke stand without repeating it. ” with a relaxed expression and no apology.

followUp.line: I understand the price; I'm still choosing the cut only.
followUp.why: It separates hearing the offer from accepting it.
followUp.delivery: Put the emphasis on “cut only,” with a relaxed expression and no apology.
